title: Landing Pad micro-hub and contextual task stream consolidation
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create a compact 'Landing Pad' micro-hub that consolidates entry points (dashboards, rollouts, recent activity, cost breakdown pill) into a single contextual task stream for faster task resumption and clearer routing. This ticket covers the high-fidelity prototype, developer handoff, and stakeholder review. Goals: reduce time-to-task by 25% for power users, make rollouts and cost lenses discoverable from the hub, and support workspace-aware routing when switching tenants. Out of scope: full backend router changes and RBAC enforcement (will be handled by follow-up engineering tickets).
acceptance_criteria: Prototype includes a landing pad header with primary actions (Search, New Route, Toggle Rollouts) and a persistent cost breakdown pill
Task stream shows contextual suggestions based on last 7 days of activity and exposes a quick-commit CTA to open a rollout canary
Figma prototype demonstrates keyboard-first navigation and accessible focus order
PM and Eng sign-off on handoff artefacts (Figma file + annotated component spec + accessibility notes)
Telemetry hooks identified (selected quick actions, workspace switch events, rollout CTA clicks) and exported to Analytics owners
design_decisions: Use a compact 56px header to preserve vertical space for the task stream on standard 1080p screens
Cost breakdown remains as a persistent pill rather than folded into a menu to avoid hiding unit economics from customers
Task stream groups items by temporal buckets (Today, Last 7 days, Older) with a condensed preview to enable quick scanning
Workspace switch is surfaced as a top-left micro-avatar menu to reduce context loss during flow switches
Phase rollout: IA-only change first (no server routing), then interactive prototypes that call stubbed APIs for rollout actions
